correctness.rationale: For A uniform GL_2(F_q), B=A^{-1}, each projective direction where coordinate-square map s([u:v])=[u²:v²] coincides with projective B determines exactly one nonzero vector x satisfying x^[2]=Bx. The equality is a nonzero homogeneous cubic so N<=3. PGL_2 acts sharply transitively on ordered triples of distinct projective points; factorial-moment incidence count gives F1=1, F2=(S1²-S2)(q-1)/[q(q²-1)], F3=(S1³-3S1 S2+2S3)/[q(q²-1)]. Odd q has fibers 1,1,2 repeated (q-1)/2, giving S2=2q,S3=4q-2, and the claimed four rational probabilities. Even q squaring is a bijection, S2=S3=q+1 giving (1/3,1/2,0,1/6). Direct independent enumeration of every invertible 2x2 matrix and nonzero x over F_3 and F_5 yields count vectors (16,20,8,4) and (160,208,64,48). The factorial-moment proof establishes all prime powers.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge PASS for the complete exact finite-field law in odd characteristic and universal probability P(N=0)=1/3 for uniformly labeled invertible 2x2 structure matrices. Kaygorodov–Martín González–Viruel 2026 survey Remark 23 provides only mean E[N]=1 and Conjecture 2 the asymptotic symmetric-group heuristic; neither specifies finite-q corrections or all four probabilities. Previous even-characteristic Frobenius-linear methods cover the even branch, not a new novelty claim. Wei–Zou counts algebra isomorphism classes under a different probability measure, not idempotents over uniform GL2.
